title: Deep debugging pass: identify and resolve failing Python pretests blocking conductor execution
summary: The conductor's pre-test gate (`tests/python/test_pipeline_extract.py` + `tests/python/test_docs.py`) had been failing 2 / 81 since `.184 / `.186, causing every subsequent experiment (.184-.187, ~24 task runs) to SKIP with self-heal failure. Root cause: README.md was overwritten by a Phase-1 HuggingFace mirror smoke-test stub (`# Carnot Smallest Test Model`) that did not contain any experiment-count label, so `test_public_docs_disclose_current_provenance_inventory` and `test_public_docs_cover_latest_pbt_and_fpga_reporting` (REQ-REPORT-003 / REQ-REPORT-004) both failed their regex `\d+[+,]?\d*\+?\s*[Ee]xperiments?` assertion. Restored README.md to a HuggingFace-compatible model-card format with current experiment / milestone counts and emoji-free copy (CLAUDE.md compliance).

root_cause_analysis.failure_signature: AssertionError: assert None where None = re.search('\\d+[+,]?\\d*\\+?\\s*[Ee]xperiments?', readme)
root_cause_analysis.diagnosed_root_cause:
README.md content was 7 lines: '---
license: apache-2.0
---
# Carnot Smallest Test Model

This is a test upload for the Carnot-EBM project. No emojis here.
'. No digit-followed-by-'experiment' substring anywhere. Overwrite occurred between commits 703f5d585 (which had the full 345-line README) and 3bfc50c1c (which had the 6-line stub).
root_cause_analysis.incident_history_pre_fix: Conductor log 2026-05-15 14:44Z through 20:31Z shows ~28 consecutive runs reporting '2 failed, 79-81 passed, 1 warning' on the smart-subset pre-test. Every experiment in `.184, `.185, `.186, `.187 that hit pre-tests SKIPPED. The cascade-failure pattern matches CLAUDE.md 'Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline' concern and led to milestone .187 doomed-rerun-block snowball.

fix_applied.format: HuggingFace model card with apache-2.0 frontmatter (HF-compatible) and CLAUDE.md-compliant emoji-free copy
fix_applied.rationale: Tests REQ-REPORT-003 (README provenance disclosure) + REQ-REPORT-004 (report+landing page disclosure) require README.md to expose at least one experiment-count label matching `\d+[+,]?\d*\+?\s*[Ee]xperiments?`. The current authoritative count source is the `results/experiment_*.json` file count (1,788 at time of fix) and `research-complete.yaml` milestone list (.187 latest). Bold-markdown was deliberately omitted between the digit-run and 'experiment' word so the regex's `\s*` separator matches whitespace cleanly rather than tripping on `**` characters.

scope_discipline.rationale: The failing tests are existing tests with valid coverage of REQ-REPORT-003/004. The breakage was a documentation regression (the README was clobbered by an in-flight HF mirror smoke-test that left the test stub committed). The minimal-blast-radius fix is to restore the document; no new spec, no new test, no new module needed. The single mutated file is README.md.

operational_impact.blocks_cleared: Every queued experiment in milestone .188 (13 tasks) and any downstream cascade was previously SKIP'd / DOOMED_RERUN_BLOCK'd at the pre-test gate. With this fix, the smart-subset pre-test goes green and the conductor's `_pretest_cache_satisfies` fingerprint will cache, unblocking downstream task execution.

decentralization_implications: No-op. README remains Apache-2.0, points to both the canonical GitHub URL (github.com/Carnot-EBM/carnot-ebm) and the HuggingFace org (huggingface.co/Carnot-EBM). The HF model-card format restoration is itself decentralization-aligned: it satisfies Rule 3 (multi-channel mirroring) by keeping the README valid as both a GitHub landing page AND a HuggingFace model card.

reproducibility.rerun_command: If pretests fail with the same regex assertion in the future, check README.md for the experiment-count label; restore via this experiment's pattern.
reproducibility.drift_signal: If `results/experiment_*.json` count diverges materially from the README count, update README — the test does NOT pin exact numbers, only requires presence of *some* experiment-count label, so drift tolerance is high.

no_doomed_rerun_check.rationale: exp1786 (`.187 Phase 0 pretest fix) hit `Reached max turns (50)` in the Claude agent at 2026-05-15 20:31 UTC without producing a fix. This task is its successor with a smaller-scope mandate (restore README only, do not modify research_conductor.py). The prior failure mode (over-broad agent task hitting turn limit) was addressed by narrowing scope per the operator's instruction: 'Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py'.

exit_disposition: Smart-subset pretest is green. Conductor is unblocked. The Haiku reconciliation step that follows this exit will sync ops/changelog.md, ops/status.md, _bmad/traceability.md per the conductor pipeline.
